:::{#def-probability}
#### Probability measure (probability function)

A **probability measure**
(also called a **probability function**
[@CaseBerg01, Definition 1.2.4])
on a [sample space](#def-sample-space) $\samplespace$,
often denoted $\Pr()$ or $\P()$,
is a [measure](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/measures.html#def-measure) on the [events](#def-event) of $\samplespace$
that gives the whole sample space probability 1
[@wikipedia_probability_space]:

$$\Pr(\samplespace) = 1$$

:::
